hero.title:
Eat well,
<accent>live well!</accent>
hero.text:
My role in public health is to promote healthy lifestyles by making nutrition science accessible.
A Université de Montréal graduate for over 25 years, I lead workshops and talks in Alberta that raise awareness of good eating habits.
hero.photoAlt: Céline Bossé, dietitian, smiling, wearing a scarf and an RD pin

mission.title: “Healthy eating at every stage of life.”
paragraphs: As a public health dietitian, my role is to raise public awareness of healthy eating.
I offer community and educational programs to promote healthy eating.
I share with my audience the joy of cooking and a taste for eating well, and so have a positive impact on their lifestyle habits while respecting each person’s cultural and social needs.

vision.quote: “Plant the seeds of your future actions… Tend them, and later you will reap the fruits. Then you will taste the fullness of accomplishment.”
vision.concepts:
The French language as a social and cultural bond.
Intergenerational synergy as a vehicle for knowledge.
Professional diversity in public health, a key to success.

whoAmI.title: “The French language and the culinary arts, always.”
whoAmI.p1: As a francophone living in a minority community, I have always carried a love of the French language and the art of cooking in my heart.
whoAmI.p2: As a mother of two and a young grandmother, my greatest joy is welcoming family and friends around a good meal. These moments of togetherness reflect my passion for cooking, my love of sharing and my immense curiosity about the endless variety of fresh, unprocessed ingredients that can be combined to delight the taste buds.
whoAmI.p3: I quickly adapted this passion for the culinary arts to everyday life and passed it on, aiming to make nutrition accessible and support well-being by offering reliable, evidence-based nutrition advice to individuals and communities. Because today, we know:

services.title: “Four ways to put health on the menu!”

items.title: Ateliers cinq épices Alberta
items.text: Every child handles, measures and cuts the food. By cooking and tasting, our little chefs discover new foods and build independence in the kitchen.

items.title: Community kitchens, from sharing to know-how
items.text: Small-group workshops to rediscover cooking skills: choosing ingredients, preparing, cooking, and how and how long to store food. Healthy, budget-friendly recipes ready in under 30 minutes.

items.title: Healthy eating promotion
items.text: Through quizzes and question games, we review your eating habits and find solutions that fit your lifestyle, at every stage of life.

items.title: Healthy eating in the workplace
items.text: One-hour interactive sessions: lunch talks, educational grocery store tours, talks, packing a lunch box and more.
